content.comment_body: I am using [company_name] [product_name] and attempting to connect a 4-20mA pressure sensor with a measurement range from -0.5 to 11 bar. I am facing difficulties because the analog amplifier configuration only permits me to set a minimum range of -5, a maximum range of 115, gain at 0.15, and offset at -35. Consequently, my actual measurement range becomes -0.5 to 11.5 bar, resulting in a deviation in the readings. Thank you for your responses! analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing limitations with the analog amplifier scaling function in the [company_name] [product_name] system. Specifically, the interface restricts input ranges, preventing direct matching to real sensor spans and causing inaccuracies in measured values and overall usability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user anticipates being able to directly enter precise calibration and scaling values to match the actual sensor range, which would allow for accurate measurement and display within the system.
